notes.title: Game Rebalancing - February 18, 2024
notes.content:
Hi all, it's been a little while since the last update but a few system changes needed to be revaluated and implemented. As of right now the game should be in a more stable state than it was before. 

Major Changes:

Berries now directly give you coin instead of having to earn it through the wine machine.
The wine machine now requires coin instead of berries to operate so be careful how you spend your coin.
The "Berries per Bottle" upgrade was removed; due to the wine machine change.
Scaling for the "Picks Per Click" upgrade was readjusted and should now scale a little less harshly.


Minor Changes:

Gnomes now a random pick time between 2.5 to 5 seconds. This was an optimization change to prevent all of them from clicking in unison whenever the game was opened.
The instructions in the main menu are shown correctly.


System Changes:
There is now a "Reset Game Save Data," button in the top right hand corner of the main menu. This does not provide any resource rewards and is only for if you want to clear your save data and start over. Resetting save data is permanent.

notes.title: Optimization and Bug Obliterations
notes.content:
Hey everyone, after about a week of picking berries and gathering bugs + issues, This first patch should address a few.
Fixes this patch:

Auto-saves will now function as intended.
The image of a cannon (R.I.P) is no longer visible in the instructions.
The berry wine cost will now scale linearly instead of exponentially.
All earned achievements should now register properly but may require a game restart.
Fixed an issue of milestones being stuck and no longer granting Gnomes.
Fixed an optimization issue where berries and wine bottles were not being removed when necessary.
The Greenhouse total berries counter should now show the accurate amount after closing and reopening the game.
The Greenhouse berry bush is now optimized to spawn berries on click instead of being pre-spawned on the bush.
Changed Gnomes to no longer scale with the "Pick Value," upgrade.


Known issues:

Frame rate falling off a cliff when an extreme amount of wine bottles are spawned in.
Audio settings vary between the options menu and the actual game.
Buttons end up crooked (just give 'em a little tap for now).


Once everything feels like it is in a stable spot performance-wise, some content updates should follow but there is no official timeline for that at the moment. Thanks for playing, and keep on berry picking.
-Azeree
